consequence.statement: A Crossplane core pod started with --enable-external-secret-stores fails to start, returning the error 'Crossplane removed support for external secret stores. The --enable-external-secret-stores flag will be removed in a future release.'
consequence.remediation: Remove --enable-external-secret-stores from the Crossplane core pod arguments (passed through the chart's args value) and migrate off external secret stores before upgrading to v2.0.0.

assertion.statement: In Crossplane v2.0.0 support for external secret stores was removed, and the core command (cmd/crossplane/core/core.go) now returns the error "Crossplane removed support for external secret stores. The --enable-external-secret-stores flag will be removed in a future release." when the --enable-external-secret-stores flag is used.
